task_text: I woke up late and have to leave for work in 10 minutes. I need something quick to eat, and the living room should be tidy so I can grab my things and go.

plans.R1:
Based on the images and the objects listed, here's a plan for preparing a quick meal:

### [0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the bread. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the bread. (r1_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the egg. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Crack the egg into the pan on the stove. (r1_s4)
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn on the stove to cook the egg. (r1_s5)

### [5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the apple from the fridge. (r1_s6)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the sliced bread on a plate from the cabinet. (r1_s7)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the cooked egg on the bread. (r1_s8)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the apple on the plate. (r1_s9)
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn off the stove. (r1_s10)

This plan provides a quick breakfast with a sandwich and an apple.

This plan ensures the living room is tidy, and you can easily grab your things and go.
